significance: An ashram at Kakraul in Madhubani district, Mithila, remembered as the seat of the Vedic sage Kapila and the Samkhya teaching, where a Shivalinga attributed to him is worshipped.
story: Kapila, born to Kardama and Devahuti, is said to have installed the Shivalinga at Kakraul, and King Siradhwaja Janaka of Mithila to have come there to learn Samkhya from him.
